title: Trump Meets the Quad in Manila.
Britain's Jobless Rate Dips.
China Hits Back Over Chip Curbs.
description: Trump meets Quad leaders in Manila amid protests, UK unemployment dips and China vows to answer US chip rules.

title: Estonia Plans a Russia Border Closure.
Britain Pitches a Brexit Reset.
Helen Haines Leaves Hospital.
description: Estonia will close its Russia border after a suspected attack, Britain eyes an EU summit and MP Helen Haines leaves hospital.

title: Houthis Gain Ground on a Key Strait.
Israel Kills a Senior Hamas Commander.
Canada Backs a Brazil-Led Forest Fund.
description: Houthis gain control near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, an Israeli strike kills a Hamas commander and Canada pledges money for a Brazil-led forest fund.

title: Trump, Putin and Xi Plan Shenzhen Talks.
UN Watchdog Flags an Unseen Iran Site.
Hungary Digs Up $19.5 Million in Cash.
description: Trump, Putin and Xi plan talks in Shenzhen, the UN watchdog flags an uninspected Iran site and Hungary seizes buried cash.

title: Europe Gets a Seat at Ukraine Talks.
Trump Says No Iran Deal Needed.
The Yen Tests 160.
description: Europe wins a place at Ukraine talks, Trump says no Iran deal is needed and the yen tests 160.

title: Indonesia’s Vice President Resigns.
Moscow Talks Lead to Another Round.
Iran Warns of Wider Retaliation.
description: Gibran submits his resignation, U.S. envoys leave Moscow after peace talks and Iran warns against renewed attacks.

title: Russia and Ukraine Agree a Swap.
Climate Leaders Demand Action.
Indonesia Faces a VP Showdown.
description: Russia and Ukraine agree a prisoner exchange, climate leaders press for action and Indonesia faces a vice presidential showdown.

title: Abu Dhabi Talks Resume.
Europe Wants a Seat.
Oil Drops Below $90.
description: Russia and Ukraine meet in Abu Dhabi, Europe presses for a role at the G7 and COP31 settles a contested agenda.

title: Climate Talks Open.
Gaza Shelters Fail.
Iraq Seeks an Oil Route.
description: COP31 opens with an electricity debate, Gaza confronts flooded shelters and Iraq describes a possible route for oil exports.

title: U.S. Broadens Iran Pressure.
Poland Begins Mourning.
Japan Assesses a Quake.
description: The U.S. expands its Iran pressure campaign beyond sea routes, Poland begins mourning and Japan assesses earthquake damage.

title: New Zealand Counts.
Iran Mediation Continues.
U.S. Hiring Strengthens.
description: New Zealand faces a close count, Qatar keeps Iran mediation active and stronger U.S. hiring complicates the economic outlook.

title: Kenya’s Cult Leader Gets 200 Years.
Lissu Faces Prison Despite Treason Acquittal.
Trump’s Arch Faces a Court Pause.
description: Kenya sentences a cult leader, Tanzania’s opposition leader faces jail despite a treason acquittal, and a court pauses Trump’s arch.

title: Europe Faces Flight Bomb Hoaxes.
Hormuz Shipping Remains at Risk.
Britain Raises Interest Rates.
description: Bomb threats disrupt European flights, Iran claims more tanker incidents and Britain raises its base rate to 4%.

title: Iran Responds to America’s Vote.
South Africa Votes on Services.
Ukraine Searches the Rubble.
description: Iran interprets America’s election, South Africans vote amid service failures and Ukraine reports a rising strike toll.

title: America votes. The world watches.
Yemen's rebels are 50 miles from Aden.
And Europe rehearses for peace in Ukraine.
description: Why Kyiv and NATO are watching the U.S. midterms, the Houthis push closer to Aden than at any time since 2015, and Europe practices sending troops to Ukraine.

title: Iran says Hormuz could reopen in two days.
Fake air raid alerts hit Ukraine and Russia.
And Canada sees a trade deal within weeks.
description: Iran names its price for reopening Hormuz, hackers send fake nuclear alerts on both sides of a war, and Canada says a U.S. trade deal could come within weeks.

title: The AI money pit spooked Wall Street.
69 died on a train in Spain.
And Poland's court fight turned physical.
description: AI spending fears give Wall Street its worst day since June, Spain blames its control room for a deadly crash, and Poland's president pushes past judges at the top court.
